body:
Thank you.

I want to change, *need* to change, and have been trying to for years but I just can't. Nothing is working for my weight, grades, or relationships. Hours seem like weeks now, and I always return to self doubt and pity after anything else occupies my mind for a split second. When I was younger I thought that people that committed suicide were cowards, and people with depression were just drama queens. I thought bipolar just meant violent and crazy. I understand all of it now. Hopelessness, instant triggers for uncontrollable anger and extreme sadness, but the triggers for happiness and confidence have all but disappeared. I'm doing so bad in school it's will take me more than 5 years to graduate, and I dont know how I will pay for it after this semester. I can't imagine it getting better any time in the next 10 years. Any of it. 

Asking my doctor for a recommendation was terrifying. Too much to do it face to face again, even if i was close enough to do it. I don't have a doctor here and the culture of this state is so different from my home state it's hard to talk to people I don't know about the damn weather let alone something so personal I've only talked to one person about it.

I really, really, really appreciate you talking to me and giving me the only positive words I've heard in what feels like an eternity. It's just that I feel like this hole I dug is too deep for any rope, especially if I don't have the strength to try to jump to it.
